When someone says "that'll never work here"

I always ask "what does work here?"

So...I "wrote" a short 13k word "book" today, while watching over sleeping sick baby. It is super rough, almost incomprehensible at the moment. Here is the MVP:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1DFNzMRbIGiwHAn5G_8yabfIURL0G1o5G/view?usp=sharing

It's based off of this image. Worth continuing? #agile #design #prodmgmt #ux

In the last two weeks I’ve had multiple #ux folk ask me whether they should become product managers.

“The PM makes the decisions. To have real impact, I need to be a PM”

My advice has been...find an org where #ux is empowered to do their job. Your skills are too valuable.

Instead of focusing on making “better” estimates ...

focus on:
- working smaller
- integrating frequently
- exposing work to users/customers sooner
- testing assumptions earlier
- limiting dependencies
- less fragile code
- limiting handoffs

Your estimates will improve

#agile
